title: Immunofluorescence Staining of Paraffin Embedded Cell Block Sections
author: Erez Nissim Baruch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6pqhdmw

steps.title: Dry and pre‑heat slides
steps.instruction: After cutting, let slides dry at room temperature overnight (or 2–3 h on a 37 °C heating plate). Then incubate the slides in an oven at 55 °C for 1–2 h before staining.

substeps.instruction: Dry at RT overnight or 2–3 h at 37 °C
Incubate in oven at 55 °C for 1–2 h

steps.title: Deparaffinize slides
steps.instruction: In a chemical hood, wash the slides in xylene for 10 min, replace with fresh xylene for another 10 min, then wash in 100 % ethanol for 3 min.

steps.title: Rehydrate slides
steps.instruction: At room temperature on the bench, wash slides in fresh 100 % ethanol for 3 min, then 95 % ethanol for 3 min, 70 % ethanol for 3 min, followed by 0.05 % Tween‑20 in PBS for 5 min and a second fresh 0.05 % Tween‑20 in PBS for 5 min.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval (microwave)
steps.instruction: Place slides in citrate buffer (1×) inside a microwave‑compatible plastic container. Microwave at maximum power for 1 min, then at minimal power for 10 min until the buffer boils. Remove the container and let the slides cool to room temperature for 15–30 min before any further washes (do not transfer slides while the buffer is still hot).

substeps.instruction: Add citrate buffer to microwave‑safe container
Max power 1 min, then low power 10 min until boil

steps.title: Post‑retrieval wash and block
steps.instruction: Wash slides in fresh 0.05 % Tween‑20 PBS for 5 min twice. Transfer slides to a staining box, add 250–300 µL of 3 % normal serum (goat, sheep, donkey or other, species different from secondary antibody) in PBS, cover with a paraffin film and incubate 60 min at room temperature. Remove the film and tap the slide dry on a paper towel.

substeps.instruction: Add 250–300 µL 3 % normal serum in PBS
Cover with paraffin film, incubate 60 min RT

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add 150–200 µL of primary antibody diluted in the same blocking solution, cover with a fresh paraffin film and incubate 60 min at room temperature or at 4 °C (if incubated at 4 °C, the slide may remain overnight).

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation and washes
steps.instruction: Remove the paraffin film, wash slides in 0.05 % Tween‑20 PBS for 5 min three times. Add 150–200 µL of secondary antibody diluted in blocking solution, cover with a paraffin film and incubate 60 min at room temperature. Wash slides in 0.05 % Tween‑20 PBS for 5 min three times, then wash with distilled deionized water (DDW) for 2 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 150–200 µL secondary antibody in blocking solution
Cover with paraffin film, incubate 60 min RT

steps.title: DAPI staining and final wash
steps.instruction: Stain slides with DAPI (1:2000 in DDW) for 2 min. Wash with DDW for 5 min, then wash in fresh 0.05 % Tween‑20 PBS for 5 min, and tap the slide dry on a paper towel.

steps.title: Mount slides
steps.instruction: Place 2–3 drops of water‑based glue on the slide, cover with a cover‑slip, wrap the slide in aluminium foil and let dry overnight.
